notes: Public source API snapshot, 2025 qualified player season records. Local DB access was denied.
velocityKmh is measured season-average pitch speed; the source excludes pitches without recorded speed.
usage is the displayed season usage percentage divided by 100; count is observed pitch count. Rounded usage may not sum to exactly 1.
AI should sample pitch type by count divided by total observed count; any exclusion of rare pitches is game tuning.
Discipline percentage fields are normalized to probabilities in [0, 1], with unavailable values null.
Movement, release location, timing windows, aim forgiveness, and control-error variance are game tuning; they are not measured here.
Optional body/jersey profile values describe the last collected game date, not necessarily the 2025 season.
